properties.displayName: Deny pl-auth A records in privatelink.azuredatabricks.net private DNS zone
properties.description: Blocks creation of any A record whose name contains 'pl-auth' inside the privatelink.azuredatabricks.net private DNS zone. These records correspond to the Azure Databricks 'browser_authentication' (Web Auth) private endpoint, which must resolve through public DNS. Registering it privately breaks Entra ID single sign-on for the workspace UI.

metadata.description: Enable or disable the execution of the policy
Substring that, when present in an A record name within the Databricks private DNS zone, triggers the effect. Defaults to 'pl-auth'.
Private DNS zone this policy applies to.
